work.summary: Fixed the apparent unused right-side slot in the five-tab navigation and extended task management for field use. Tasks can now target one explicitly selected vending machine in addition to existing all/manufacturer-wide targeting. Each task can define a 1–100% completion threshold; legacy tasks default to 100%, existing tasks can edit it, and the parent task completes automatically as soon as completed-target ratio reaches or exceeds the threshold.
implemented: Changed top navigation to explicit flex distribution so all five remaining tabs consume the full row.
Added task target mode selector: manufacturer/all or single vending machine.
Added searchable single-machine picker to new task creation.
Added completionThresholdPercent to tasks with 1–100 normalization and legacy default 100.
Added load-time migration/default for existing tasks and a completion sweep for threshold-qualified tasks.
Added editable threshold to Task Detail for existing active tasks.
Updated task progress, history and target labels to show threshold/progress.
Auto-completion uses exact integer ratio comparison: done*100 >= threshold*total.
Added tests/task-target-threshold-ui-gate.html covering full-width five-tab navigation, single-machine task creation, legacy threshold editing, and 70% auto-completion.
PR #139 browser regression run 37318687576 passed all five gates.
Main browser regression run 37318820245 passed all five gates.
Vercel production status for the main merge passed.
